title: Tormach post: end the program with G53 G0 Z0 only - drop the trailing G30 (it drives Z back down to a low G30)

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
**Request (the user, from a PathPilot Hub run of PR #1577's kit, 2026-11-13):** they saw the program end go up and then come back down. Asked how a program should end, they chose to drop the `G53 G0 Z0` and keep `G30`, and in their words: "I would expect there to be a G0 A0. (if there is a 4th axis) --- but the G53 G0 Z0 perhaps should not be there".

**Today** (`assets/posts/tormach.cps`, `retract()` and `onClose()`): the program ends `M9`, `M5`, `G53 G0 Z0`, `G30`, `M30`. In the Hub the `G53 G0 Z0` lifted to the top of travel, then `G30` brought Z back down to the sim's stored G30 position (machine Z -1.5611), which looks like the tool dropping back toward the part.

**Asked for:**
1. End the program with `G30` (the operator's preset G30 / unload position) and no `G53 G0 Z0` before it.
2. On a machine with a 4th axis, return the rotary with `G0 A0` at the end.

**Safety:** this changes posted G-code and is under the safety floor, so it needs a safety-tier review. The current order is deliberate.
- The post's own comments (#495, #785, PR #798) note that a G30 with no axis words moves EVERY axis to the stored position (LinuxCNC params 5181-5189), X, Y and A included, so Z goes straight up first.
- Without the lift, a G30 whose stored position includes X/Y, or a Z below the part top, rapids there **from the last cutting height** and could cross the part or the vise.
- The design must keep the end safe whatever the operator's G30 holds. Options:
  - drop the lift only when the machine file states the G30 position is Z-only and above the part;
  - keep a lift to a clearance height in work coordinates (above the stock) instead of machine Z0;
  - make the ending a post option, with today's order as the default.
- The worker records the chosen option and why in `docs/decisions/`.
- **Where `G0 A0` goes:** after Z is clear of the part, never before.

**Done means:**
- The Tormach program end follows the request, or a safe variant of it, with the reasoning in the decision file.
- A machine with a 4th axis ends with `G0 A0` after the tool is clear.
- The affected Tormach NC goldens are regenerated and explained.
- A pin shows no end move rapids X/Y below the clearance height.
- The PathPilot Hub kit runs to M30 on the 770MX sim.

Related: #495, #785, PR #798, PR #1577 (whose Hub run surfaced this).
